git add cmd/beadle-email/email_cmd.go cmd/beadle-email/email_cmd_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(email): resolveConfig honors explicit -c/--config, skips identity lookup

The 8 mail commands sharing resolveConfig (list, search, read, send, reply,
move, mark, folders) never gained the explicit -c/--config override that
doctor/status already have via cmd.Flags().Changed("config") — an
inconsistency this branch itself introduced by fixing doctor/status but not
their siblings. `doctor -c X` could report OK while a mail command still
consulted a different, possibly-corrupt identity config doctor's -c never
checked. resolveConfig now takes the *cobra.Command and skips identity-config
lookup entirely when the flag was passed explicitly, matching doctor/status's
loadConfigForCmd precedence. Also restores the diagnostic log for the
identity-absent soft-fallback case, matching the other three fallback
branches this function already logs.
EOF
)"
